scope: Read-only follow-up on full tube-test, forced-swim and tail-suspension data availability, archive contents, historical source trees and split preprocessing

verified_release_state.historical_tree_findings: The documentation branch and the first Neuron-BERT addition contain the same sole validation cache. The initial repository tree has no matching tube/FST/TST data payload. The Neuron-BERT path history lists four commits; later changes concern licensing and documentation.

archive_directory_inspection.method: Two bounded anonymous HTTPS Range reads: ZIP end record and central directory. Both required 206 responses and exact response lengths. No archive entry was decompressed or executed.
archive_directory_inspection.other_pickle_files: Three 361-byte SAM2Mice benchmark-result files, not the requested neural decoding data

split_preprocessing_findings.source_observation: The trial splitter copies every non-trial field, including calcium_whole, into each split. The dataset class fits StandardScaler and PCA on each whole-session calcium matrix, then extracts the selected trial intervals.
split_preprocessing_findings.consequence: The published validation features do not establish train-only preprocessing. A random repartition of the 17 cached examples cannot undo the original whole-session transform.
split_preprocessing_findings.independent_bpb_split_route: With original target signals and labels, freeze whole-session or mouse-pair groups before fitting the submitted model. Verify global animal mapping before claiming animal-disjoint evaluation. Use original variable-neuron inputs, common anatomical features, or a separately specified calibration interval; otherwise declare session-level unsupervised adaptation explicitly.
split_preprocessing_findings.model_policy: Train a new reference on the BPB Train role. Do not use the author's validation-selected best_model as evidence for an independent BPB Test.

tube_test: Original data_aligned.pkl or equivalent numeric calcium matrices
Winner labels and exact trial time_start_end
Stable recording/session identifiers and input animal ordering
Animal mapping sufficient for the chosen grouping claim
forced_swim: Original AUC curve type, class order and multiclass aggregation or scorer code
tail_suspension: Recording/animal membership and original score aggregation

access_and_inference_limits: The Nature article HTML fetch returned an identity-provider redirect. This follow-up does not claim a fresh reading of its full Data Availability text.
The author's lab dataset page lists no additional Airscope dataset. The historical Drive code URL returned a page with no parsable file items; this does not prove that the underlying folder is empty.
The previously denied frames.zip route was not retried or bypassed. The toolbox archive inspected here is a separate public file with successful Range access.
Absence from these checked releases is not proof that the authors possess no additional data.
The earlier 17-example cache inspection remains separate evidence. This follow-up did not reread its neural arrays or publish per-trial labels.
A 17-example cache-derived demonstration would be a separate small-task adaptation, not completion of the planned full Airscope tasks.
recommended_next_step: Request the experiment-specific numeric signal/label files and split metadata from the authors. No official new test release is necessary if these inputs permit a documented independent BrainPilotBench partition.
